about: Organic objects for SDF modeling (#42). No expected bounding box: parts are scored by the visual judge (eval/judge.py) against the request. 'subject' names the object (the SDF examples must not include it, tests/test_sdf.py); 'search' is what the thingiverse config searches for. Requests read like the gate's organic_spec: what the object looks like and how big it is.

cases.subject: cat
cases.request: A sitting cat about 50 mm tall, tail curled around its front paws, ears pointing up.

cases.subject: horse
cases.request: A standing horse figurine, 60 mm tall, four legs, long neck and head raised, a tail hanging down.

cases.subject: frog
cases.request: A frog sitting on its folded back legs, about 40 mm long, with big bulging eyes on top of its head.

cases.subject: tulip
cases.request: A tulip flower 80 mm tall: a cup-shaped bloom of petals on a straight stem with two long leaves, on a small round base.

cases.subject: octopus
cases.request: A cartoon octopus 50 mm tall: a round head and eight curling tentacles spread around it on the ground.

cases.subject: owl
cases.request: An owl figurine 50 mm tall: an egg-shaped body, a round face with two large eyes and a small beak, ear tufts, wings folded at the sides.

cases.subject: rubber duck
cases.request: A rubber duck, 45 mm tall, with a flat bottom so it stands.

cases.subject: dinosaur
cases.request: A long-necked dinosaur (brontosaurus) 80 mm long: a heavy body on four pillar legs, a long neck with a small head, and a long tail.

cases.subject: hand
cases.request: A human hand, palm open with fingers spread, standing upright on its wrist, 90 mm tall.

cases.subject: apple
cases.request: An apple 50 mm wide with a short stem and one leaf.

cases.subject: dolphin
cases.request: A dolphin leaping in an arc, 70 mm long, with a dorsal fin, flippers and a tail fluke, the tail touching a small round base.

cases.subject: turtle
cases.request: A turtle 60 mm long: a domed shell, four stubby legs, a head poking out the front and a short tail.
